paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge

model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accumulation capacity (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis represents the co-occurrence number, displayed on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1.0 to 10^10, with values incrementing by powers of ten. The y-axis represents the ACC, measured as a percentage, with scale ranging from 60% to 80%, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 5%. The first line, colored black and marked with circular markers, begins at approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 1.0 and gradually increases to approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 10^10. A second line, colored dark gray and marked with diamond markers, starts at approximately 65% at 1.0 and reaches approximately 75% at 10^10. A third line, colored light blue and marked with triangular markers, initiates at approximately 68% at 1.0, rises to approximately 72% at 10^10, and then decreases slightly. A fourth line, colored red and marked with rounded square markers, starts at approximately 65% at 1.0 and steadily increases to approximately 77% at 10^10. Finally, a fifth line, colored dark purple and marked with hexagonal markers, begins at approximately 63% at 1.0, increases to approximately 74% at 10^10.
